resources.string: Beep when you ride faster than the speed below for longer than the delay while the ride timer is stopped, paused or never started.
Beep when the timer runs and you are moving but the ride distance has not changed.
Alert: heart rate or power lost
Beep (three times, a minute apart) when heart rate or power was seen earlier in this ride and then goes missing.
Above this speed you count as moving. Set it above your custom auto-pause speed.
How long you must be moving with the timer not running before the alert.
How long the distance may stay unchanged while moving before the alert.
How long heart rate or power may be missing before the alert.
While a problem lasts, the alert repeats at this interval. Sensor alerts stop after three beeps.
Show rotating help pages until the ride starts.
